description: This file defines a PHP trait named CategoryRelationsTrait which adds methods for managing category relationships within models. It provides functionality to add, replace, remove, and fetch categories associated with a model, assuming a specific naming convention for relationship tables and fields.

classes.name: CategoryRelationsTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait that provides methods to manage category relationships for any model class that uses it, assuming conventional table and field naming.

methods.name: getCategoryRelationalTable
methods.description: Returns the name of the relational table for categories based on the current model's table name.

methods.name: addCategories
methods.description: Adds categories to the model, optionally removing categories not in the provided list.

methods.name: replaceCategories
methods.description: Replaces all current categories with a new set of categories.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves category objects associated with the model, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: removeCategories
methods.description: Removes specified categories from the model.

methods.name: getMainCategory
methods.description: Returns the first category associated with the model, or null if none.
